patterns.note: Asymmetrical product grid layouts that mix single large product images with two-column or three-column arrangements, breaking the monotony of uniform grids.
Consistent use of a wide, uppercase sans-serif for prominent headings and calls to action, paired with a clean, standard sans-serif for body text and product details.
A predominantly monochromatic palette of black, white, and various shades of grey, allowing the metallic tones and subtle colors of the jewelry to stand out as primary visual interest.

The hero image features a subtle parallax effect, scrolling slower than the foreground content. Product sections and individual items reveal with a gentle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport.
Interspersed editorial-style full-width image sections with artistic still-life photography, providing visual breaks and reinforcing the brand's high-concept aesthetic.

technique_notes: Uses a scroll library (like locomotive-scroll) to create a subtle parallax effect on the hero image, where the background scrolls slower than the foreground text. Content sections and individual product items are revealed with a staggered fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport. The main navigation transforms into a sticky, compact bar after scrolling past the hero.

design_tokens.type_scale: A clear hierarchy with a wide, uppercase sans-serif for hero text, balanced sans-serif for product titles, and smaller, lighter sans-serif for prices and details.
design_tokens.spacing: airy and minimalist, with generous whitespace around product displays and between sections, creating a premium and uncluttered feel.

standout: The site's distinctive blend of minimalist e-commerce with high-concept, editorial-style photography elevates product presentation beyond typical catalog shots. The use of artistic still-life compositions and abstract imagery (like the onion teapot or deconstructed jewelry) creates a unique brand identity that feels more like an art gallery than a retail store.
